name: Sangrur, Punjab
story: Hero field: severe borewell aquifer depletion (-3.85 cm/yr regional TWS trend), intensive puddled rice–wheat monoculture, and October–November stubble burning crunch.

name: Ludhiana, Punjab
story: Intensive irrigated rice–wheat belt benchmarked against Punjab Agricultural University (PAU) long-term agronomic trials for PR-126, DSR, and Happy Seeder.

name: Bathinda, Punjab
story: Lighter sandy-loam soils, lower monsoon rainfall (~440 mm), brackish groundwater, and high March terminal heat—evaluating cotton, bajra, guar, chickpea, and mustard rotations.

name: Yavatmal (Vidarbha), Maharashtra
story: Rainfed deep black clay soil (Vertisol) prone to prolonged mid-monsoon dry spells—diversifying from high-risk cotton monoculture to soybean–chickpea and pigeon pea intercrops.

name: Jhansi (Bundelkhand), Uttar Pradesh
story: Chronic water scarcity and shallow red-black soils with high runoff—transitioning to drought-hardy pearl millet, sorghum, urad, groundnut, lentil, and mustard rotations.

name: Thanjavur (Cauvery Delta), Tamil Nadu
story: Frost-free tropical delta with SW + NE monsoon bimodal rain—replacing water-heavy double puddled paddy with DSR + rice-fallow blackgram (urad) and greengram (moong) pulses.
